title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
content: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
content: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

title: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
content: The venture, known as Project Faro, plans to issue a dollar-denominated stablecoin and is expected to be incorporated in the U.S.

title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps
content: Twice now, crypto firms have found themselves on the side of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission in holding that perpetual futures aren't swaps.

title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
content: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.

title: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
content: The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform.

title: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
content: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.

title: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
content: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.

title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
content: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
content: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.

title: Nvidia Erases 2026 Gains as Republicans Threaten Jensen Huang With Subpoena
content: The chipmaker has erased its 2026 gains as a suspected Chinese espionage case brings fresh scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang.

title: Near AI Breach Exposes User Details and Data From 18 AI Agents
content: An SGLang flaw let an attacker reach internal systems and potentially view confidential AI requests, exposing the limits of hardware-backed privacy protections.

title: Elon Musk Calls Claude Opus 5.5 a 'Masterpiece', Admits Grok 4.8 Won't Match It
content: Elon Musk says the incoming Grok 4.8 will trail Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5, praising his rival’s model while predicting Grok 5 could surpass it in two or three months.

title: Grayscale Bets $1 Million on Zcash as Privacy Coin Tumbles
content: Grayscale plans to direct $1 million from its Zcash ETF fees to ecosystem nonprofits and launched a national ad campaign, as ZEC fell more than 11%.

title: Goldman, Citi and Global Banks Commit $270 Million to Challenge Crypto’s Stablecoin Giants
content: The funding, backing a U.S.-incorporated issuer codenamed “Project Faro,” covers five years of operations as traditional lenders move to challenge crypto-native giants Tether and Circle.

title: LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds
content: Bitcoin Magazine LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds LNbits released version 1.7.0 on November 10 as an urgent security update following active attacks that began November 8. Operators must upgrade before restarting servers as prior versions put funds at risk of theft. This post LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .

title: Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin
content: Bitcoin Magazine Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin Rep. Ron Reynolds filed House Bill 815 on Monday, allowing each Texas city or county to put up to $10 million of public money into bitcoin starting Sept. 1, 2027. This post Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review
content: Bitcoin Magazine Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review Poland's Sejm passed a sanctions bill Friday that lets the interior minister freeze bitcoin and bank funds of people on a national list, and a court appeal would not pause the freeze. This post Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Canaan (CAN) Swings to an $8 Million Profit on Bitcoin Gains as Rig Sales Collapse 96%
content: Bitcoin Magazine Canaan (CAN) Swings to an $8 Million Profit on Bitcoin Gains as Rig Sales Collapse 96% Canaan's mining-machine sales fell to $4.8 million from $118.6 million a year earlier, but a $51.9 million fair-value gain turned an operating loss into $8.0 million of net income. This post Canaan (CAN) Swings to an $8 Million Profit on Bitcoin Gains as Rig Sales Collapse 96% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Binance Warns iOS Flaw Could Expose Wallet Seed Phrases as Apple’s Latest iPhone Patch Stays Silent
content: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Warns iOS Flaw Could Expose Wallet Seed Phrases as Apple’s Latest iPhone Patch Stays Silent Binance told iPhone users a public iOS sandbox escape called worse_query could let malicious apps read seed phrases and private keys stored by other apps, while Apple's Nov. 9 updates do not mention the bug. This post Binance Warns iOS Flaw Could Expose Wallet Seed Phrases as Apple’s Latest iPhone Patch Stays Silent first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
